name: NormalizeLatent to a per-channel dynamic range (only expands)
plain: Scales a sample's channel so its largest absolute value reaches a format-specific constant, with the ratio floored at 1, so it can only enlarge. The constants are by format. Unknown formats pass through.
math:
ratio=r/max(|min|,|max|); x*=max(ratio,1)
SD15 r=[18,14,14,14]; SDXL r=[20,16,16]
